title: Vizcaya #1001 | KEY.co
description_expanded: Vizcaya #1001 offers a luxurious Gulf-front retreat in the exclusive gated community of Vizcaya in Santa Rosa Beach. This meticulously cared-for home boasts three bedrooms and two and a half baths, accommodating up to six guests in style. With plush furnishings, high-end finishes, and a chef's kitchen equipped with state-of-the-art appliances, every detail has been thoughtfully designed to provide the utmost comfort and elegance. The spacious open-concept living and dining area is perfect for relaxing, with generous windows offering stunning coastal views and a large, comfortable sofa for family gatherings. Whether you're cooking in the gourmet kitchen or enjoying a meal at the dining table, this home seamlessly blends relaxation and sophistication. Step outside to discover the breathtaking outdoor spaces, including a private balcony perfect for unwinding after a day of adventure. With paddleboards, four bikes, and private beach access just steps away, exploring the beauty of 30A is effortless. Start your day by swimming in the community pool or exploring the scenic Timpoochee Trail. After a fun day, enjoy fresh local seafood at nearby favorites like Shunk Gulley Oyster Bar or Goatfeathers. Vizcaya #1001 is more than just a vacation home; it's a haven where luxury meets coastal living, offering an unforgettable experience in one of 30A's most prestigious communities.
